title: Implement all remaining issues in priority order

effects: Release and CI policy, runtime contracts, generated projections, package documentation, and focused tests may change.

claims: Implement all remaining issues in priority order is implemented, validated, and closed out honestly.

Verify each pull request maps every claimed issue acceptance criterion to executable or live evidence.
